message:
🔒 CWE-79 OWASP:A05-Injection CVSS:6.1 | Assigning to innerHTML with template literal with expressions can execute malicious scripts. This is a critical XSS vulnerability. | CRITICAL [SOC2,PCI-DSS,GDPR,ISO27001]
   Fix: Sanitize with DOMPur

🔒 CWE-401 OWASP:A06-Vulnerable CVSS:5.3 | URL.createObjectURL() creates a reference that persists until explicitly revoked. Without revokeObjectURL(), memory leaks occur. | MEDIUM
   Fix: Call URL.revokeObjectURL(blobUrl) when the URL is n

🔒 CWE-319 OWASP:A02-Security CVSS:7.5 | Enforce HTTPS for all external requests detected - this is a security risk | HIGH
   Fix: Review and apply secure practices | https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/319.html

🔒 CWE-798 OWASP:A04-Cryptographic CVSS:9.8 | Credentials detected in URL query parameters - this is a security risk | CRITICAL [SOC2,PCI-DSS,HIPAA,GDPR]
   Fix: Use secure methods: POST body, headers (Authorization), or secure cookies | ht

⚠️ CWE-319 OWASP:A02-Cryptographic CVSS:5.3 | HTTP URL detected: "http://api.com/path/resource" | MEDIUM
   Fix: Use HTTPS or add to allowedHosts config | https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/319.html
